summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 24, 2026, announcing that CEO Jorge A. Ganoza will present at Mining Forum Americas 2026, held September 27-30 at The Broadmoor in Colorado Springs, with his presentation on Monday, September 28 at 11:00 a.m. MDT. No transaction, securities offering, or corporate action is disclosed; the release also restates the company's target of roughly 500,000 gold-equivalent ounces annually from H2 2028. This is a routine investor-conference scheduling notice, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
